description: Fields set by environment variables are ignored. The change is applied before it is saved: when applying fails, nothing is saved.

write_log_files.description: Write the error and stream log files; forced on by GOA (env LOGROTATE)

goaccess.description: GoAccess report (env GOA); applies after a container restart

goaccess_keep_days.description: GoAccess keeps report data for this many days (--keep-last). Applies after a container restart

goaccess_anonymize.description: Anonymize visitor IPs in the GoAccess report: off or the --anonymize-level. Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_drop_query_strings.description: Drop query strings from the URLs in the GoAccess report (--no-query-string). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_real_os.description: Full operating system versions in the GoAccess report (--real-os). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_resolve_hosts.description: Resolve visitor host names in the GoAccess report (--with-output-resolver). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA
